description: Defines the Element class for the Goteo SuperForm library, implementing form element rendering, type determination, and view handling.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties for rendering, validation, and content management.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Element object with provided data, sets type and view.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view path for rendering the element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the element based on class name.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML content of the element.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create and render an Element from data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the element using a view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the element to a string by rendering it, handling exceptions.
